title: 03/06/2017 - Software Updates
text:
## 03/06/2017 - Software Updates
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000026453
Brilliant Directories made the following updates to these default widgets and Core functionality. If you have customized any of these widgets, and would like to update your customized widget, you can find our most updated code in the Default Widget section. If you have a custom version of these widgets, it means that our latest updates have not been pushed to your website.
Updates:
Now the Members under Products that have set the Listing Searchable on Website as No will be able to publish Regular Post(articles,events,coupons) and Photo Album Post(Photo albums, classifieds, properties). Widgets Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Display - Recent Articles, Bootstrap Theme - Display - Recent Articles with Sidebar, Bootstrap Theme - Display - Recent Blog Articles, Bootstrap Theme - Display - Recent Blog Articles with Sidebar, Bootstrap Theme - Display - Recent Classifieds, Bootstrap Theme - Display - Recent Coupons, Bootstrap Theme - Display - Recent Events, Bootstrap Theme - Display - Recent Jobs, Bootstrap Theme - Display - Recent Photo Albums, Bootstrap Theme - Display - Recent Products, Bootstrap Theme - Display - Recent Properties, Bootstrap Theme - Display - Recent Videos, Search - Group - Search Query.
The Get Match Form is now available to be displayed in the Homepage instead of the Website Searches, this new feature can be controlled by the Design Settings. Widgets Involved: Bootstrap - Contact Member Lead Map, Bootstrap Theme - Display - Contact Form Thank You Message.
The hero divider has been enhanced and now you can add an URL which will create a link option for each of the 3 hero divider elements, Widgets involved: Bootstrap Theme - Homepage - Hero Divider, Bootstrap Theme - Custom Appearance Settings.
On member search results, the system is shows the correct image for each member listing. To get this update, please use the Feature Recovery Code.
Moreover,We fixed the issue related that prevented you to create a new Website Sitemap with the Sitemap Generator Tool.
